Subject: POC setup gaps — shepherding offer & suggested cutover date

Hi Samira / Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC producing telemetry as soon as possible: 

Action items (owners):
- Provide sandbox credentials for the ingestion endpoint (NovoPay) — Samira
- Confirm sample dataset (schema & obfuscation) — Alex
- Redwood: provide minimal config + quickstart checklist and one-hour remote pairing session

I've attached a short setup checklist that covers the three things we saw blocking setup in the call. If it's helpful, we can schedule a 60-minute pairing session next week to walk through access issues and push a test inference through the pipeline. My calendar is open Tue/Wed afternoon PT; happy to adapt.

Suggested cutover window: if we can complete access + dataset validation by Oct 12, we can produce initial latency/cost estimates and a short demo within 5 business days. If that timeline no longer works on your side, let me know — we can adjust cadence or scope.

Attachments: novo_poc_setup_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), env_access_instructions.txt (plain text)

Thanks,

Wanted to follow up one last time this week. We've blocked a couple of pairing slots (Oct 20 & Oct 21) with an infra engineer and can run a focused 90-minute session to finish the sandbox ingestion and confirm a test inference. If you can confirm one slot by Oct 18, we'll: 

- include one infra pairing session (90 minutes, remote) at no charge
- extend the POC evaluation window by two weeks so your product team has time to validate results

These two concessions are intended purely to remove logistical blockers — no changes to pricing or SLAs. If you'd prefer not to take the pairing, that's fine; otherwise I can hold the Oct 20 slot for you until EOD Oct 18.

If the program doesn't fit your current priorities, a quick note with a new target date is enough and we'll pause outreach.

Thanks for considering — happy to chat live if easier.
